headline: Committee recommends passage of energy contract financing, discusses grant rules

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: The committee voted to recommend passage, as amended, of a resolution to finance a Johnson Controls Inc. energy contract by lease purchase. On the grants rules bill, staff will ask the administration when rulemaking is required.
meeting.recap: The committee continued a meeting that was recessed on June 16 because of technical difficulties.[[0:02:02]] The first item was a resolution to finance a Johnson Controls Inc. energy contract through a tax-exempt lease purchase with TD Equipment Finance Inc.[[0:21:36]] The proposed cost for Phase 3 is $9,021,259 plus 4.49 percent interest.[[0:22:14]] During testimony, a speaker said they do not consent to the energy contract.[[0:24:30]] The committee approved an amendment letting the final financed amount come in lower than the amount stated.[[0:45:54]] The committee voted to recommend passage of the resolution as amended.[[0:47:27]] The second item was Bill 73, which would require countywide administrative rules for the County Grants Program.[[0:48:10]] A council member asked staff to send the administration a question about when formal rulemaking is required.[[1:17:12]]
meeting.next: Staff will send the administration a question on when rulemaking is required instead of internal policies. The chair said the rulemaking question would be clarified by the next meeting.

moments.q: "At the end of the lease period, it is a county asset."
"There is no guarantee that they will be approved by August 15th date."

issues.oneLine: A council member said county grant funds for homeless outreach are sometimes rejected by the department.
issues.why: The member said nonprofits working in the community need the funding to keep operating.
issues.brief: The member said staff reported that HUD is not following the Housing First model.[[#1]]
